meta.title: Lingo - AI In-Game Chat Translator for Multiplayer Games
meta.description: Lingo is an AI-powered in-game chat translator for Windows and macOS. Translate team chat in Dota 2, LoL, WoW, Overwatch 2, and more with one hotkey.
meta.keywords: AI game translator, in-game chat translator, game chat translation, Dota 2 chat translator, League of Legends translator, World of Warcraft translator, Overwatch 2 translator, multilingual gaming chat, Windows game translator, macOS game translator

hero.title: Instant Team Chat Translation
hero.subtitle: Translate live game chat, reply naturally, and keep your squad aligned across Chinese, English, and Russian with one hotkey.
hero.supportLine: Built for Dota 2, LoL, WoW, Overwatch 2, and any game with text chat.

mockup.title: Translate precisely, send instantly
mockup.body: Type your message in Chinese, press the hotkey, and Lingo translates gaming terms like BKB, engage, and hold into natural English — then pastes it right back into chat.
mockup.source: 先别接，等我 BKB 好了我们再打。
mockup.result: Don't force yet. Wait for my BKB, then we take the fight.
mockup.chatDraft: Don't force yet. Wait for my BKB, then we take the fight.
mockup.sideBody: Concise sentences, consistent tone, and low-friction communication for live matches.

features.title: More than translation. Your in-game communication assistant.
features.subtitle: Lingo doesn't just translate words — it turns callouts and game terms into natural, send-ready messages with a single hotkey.

instant.title: One-key translate
instant.description: Select text or type your message, press the hotkey, and let AI handle the translation and formatting.

server.title: Context-aware AI
server.description: Translation models run server-side with continuous updates, producing shorter, cleaner, and more game-appropriate output.

phrases.title: Quick-send phrases
phrases.description: Common callouts like push, back, wait, and regroup are pre-loaded and ready to send instantly.

languages.title: Cross-language communication
languages.description: Translate seamlessly between Chinese, English, and Russian to communicate naturally across any server.

supportedGames.title: Deeply optimized for popular multiplayer games.
supportedGames.subtitle: Starting with Dota 2, League of Legends, World of Warcraft, and Overwatch 2 — with support for any game that has a text chat.
supportedGames.note: If a game has a chat box, Lingo can connect to it — helping you understand faster and reply more effectively.

dota2.name: Dota 2
dota2.description: Optimized for smoke calls, BKB timing, retreat pings, and the short tactical lines that decide team fights.

lol.name: League of Legends
lol.description: Lane calls, jungle timing, resource trades, and teamfight coordination — translated naturally like a real teammate.

wow.name: World of Warcraft
wow.description: Raid commands, regroup reminders, party chat, and multilingual group coordination made seamless.

ow2.name: Overwatch 2
ow2.description: Position callouts, focus targets, regroup timing, and push commands — translated concisely and accurately.

howItWorks.title: Three steps from thought to team chat.
howItWorks.subtitle: Type your intent, let AI translate it into natural game language, and send it straight to chat.

select.title: Type your message
select.description: Enter what you want to say, or select a teammate's message to translate.

hotkey.title: Press the hotkey
hotkey.description: One shortcut triggers translation and optimization — AI handles everything in between.

paste.title: Confirm and send
paste.description: The translated result auto-fills the chat box, ready to send with a single click.

download.title: Install now and start communicating with AI in your next match.
download.subtitle: Direct official downloads are delivered through our Tencent Cloud mirror for faster regional access.
